title: SDF-Aware Weighting: Adaptive Eikonal Regularisation for Three-Dimensional Level-Set Physics-Informed Neural Networks
abstract: arXiv:2608.08322v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Adaptive loss-balancing schemes for physics-informed neural networks rest on a premise that every residual should be driven to zero. For level-set advection with an eikonal regulariser that premise fails: the eikonal term penalises deviation of $\lVert\nabla\phi\rVert$ from unity, a property transport preserves only under rigid motion; where the exact solution departs from a signed-distance function the eikonal residual of the correct answer is nonzero, and driving it to zero moves the network away from that answer. We show that standard gradient-norm balancing fails in exactly this way, its weight remaining near its initial value throughout training on benchmarks where the property is violated, and we introduce SDF-Aware Weighting (SAW), which combines a residual-quantile gate with a gradient-norm ratio so that points exhibiting legitimate departure are excluded before the surviving term is scaled. translated_title: SDF感知加权：面向三维水平集物理信息神经网络的自适应Eikonal正则化
translated_abstract: 物理信息神经网络的自适应损失平衡方案建立在一个前提之上：每个残差都应被驱动到零。然而对于带Eikonal正则化项的水平集输运问题，这一前提并不成立：Eikonal项惩罚‖∇φ‖偏离1的程度，而该性质仅在刚体运动下才会被输运过程保持；在精确解偏离符号距离函数（SDF）之处，正确答案的Eikonal残差本身就是非零的，若强行将其驱动到零，反而会使网络偏离正确解。我们证明标准的梯度范数平衡方法恰恰以这种方式失效——在违反该性质的基准测试上，其权重在整个训练过程中始终停留在初始值附近。为此，我们提出SDF感知加权（SAW），该方法将残差分位数门控与梯度范数比率相结合，先排除那些表现出合理偏离的点，再对剩余项进行缩放。在四个三维基准测试上（原文此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出SDF感知加权（SAW），通过残差分位数门控与梯度范数比率相结合的自适应机制，排除了精确解合理偏离符号距离函数的区域，从而修正了传统损失平衡方法盲目将Eikonal残差压至零的根本缺陷，显著提升了三维水平集物理信息神经网络的求解精度。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes SDF-Aware Weighting (SAW), which combines a residual-quantile gate with a gradient-norm ratio to exclude points where the exact solution legitimately departs from a signed-distance function, thereby fixing the fundamental flaw of blindly driving the eikonal residual to zero and significantly improving 3D level-set physics-informed neural networks.
